name: Reflection::Module.invoke reaches a Module method and revalidates its receiver

input.source_text: module Mo { public fun h(x: Integer) -> Integer { x + 1 } }; class A { }; let m = Reflection::Module.method(Mo, :h); [Reflection::Module.invoke(m, Mo, [4]), try { Reflection::Module.invoke(m, A.new(), []) } catch e { e }]

applicability.reason: Reflective Module invocation has no native boundary.
